task.prompt:
We have a PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL stored procedure whose current implementation is attached as current_procedure.sql. It is functionally correct and defines the required behaviour. On real data volumes it runs too slowly.

When a performance row has Attendance less than para_Attendance, the procedure sets its "integer" column to 'staging'.

Please rewrite the attached procedure so that it does exactly the same thing with less database work. For every input, the final database state must be identical to what the attached procedure produces.

The procedure must keep exactly this signature and parameter list:
sp(para_Num_of_Pieces integer, para_Performance_ID integer, para_Attendance integer, para_integer text)

Return only the complete stored procedure and nothing else.

ledger.key: what did the omitted region of the current procedure (lines 1-1) contain?
ledger.answer: UPDATE "member_attendance" SET "Performance_ID" = CONCAT("Performance_ID", '_updated') WHERE ctid = rec.row_id;

ledger.key: Which value does the procedure assign to the "integer" column when Attendance is below para_Attendance?
ledger.answer: The procedure assigns var2 to the "integer" column in that branch; 'staging' is not used.

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp_orig(para_Num_of_Pieces integer, para_Performance_ID integer, para_Attendance integer, para_integer text) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT "Attendance", "integer" FROM "performance" WHERE "Attendance" > para_Attendance; rec RECORD; att RECORD; var1 integer; var2 text; v_attendance integer; v_integer text; BEGIN var1 := para_Num_of_Pieces * 2; var2 := para_Performance_ID::text; IF para_Num_of_Pieces < 10 THEN FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Num_of_Pieces" FROM "member_attendance" LOOP IF rec."Num_of_Pieces" < var1 THEN UPDATE "member_attendance" SET "Num_of_Pieces" = "Num_of_Pieces" + para_Performance_ID WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Attendance", "integer" FROM "performance" LOOP IF rec."Attendance" = para_Attendance AND rec."integer" LIKE var2 THEN DELETE FROM "performance" WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Attendance" FROM "performance" LOOP IF rec."Attendance" = para_Attendance THEN UPDATE "performance" SET "Location" = CONCAT("Location", ':', var2) WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Attendance" FROM "performance" LOOP IF rec."Attendance" >= var1 THEN UPDATE "performance" SET "Host" = CONCAT("Host", ':', var2) WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; ELSIF para_Num_of_Pieces < 20 THEN OPEN cur; LOOP FETCH cur INTO rec; EXIT WHEN NOT FOUND; v_attendance := rec."Attendance"; v_integer := rec."integer"; FOR att IN SELECT ctid AS row_id FROM "member_attendance" WHERE "Num_of_Pieces" = v_attendance LOOP UPDATE "member_attendance" SET "Performance_ID" = v_integer WHERE ctid = att.row_id; END LOOP; var1 := var1 + 1; END LOOP; CLOSE cur; ELSIF para_Num_of_Pieces < 30 THEN FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Attendance" FROM "performance" LOOP IF rec."Attendance" < para_Attendance THEN UPDATE "performance" SET "integer" = var2 WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id FROM "member_attendance" LOOP UPDATE "performance" SET "integer" = 'staging' WHERE "Attendance" < para_Attendance; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Attendance" FROM "performance" LOOP IF rec."Attendance" % 5 = 0 THEN DELETE FROM "performance" WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; ELSIF para_Num_of_Pieces < 40 THEN FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id FROM "member_attendance" LOOP IF para_Performance_ID > 50 THEN UPDATE "member_attendance" SET "Num_of_Pieces" = "Num_of_Pieces" / 2 WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; ELSE UPDATE "member_attendance" SET "Num_of_Pieces" = "Num_of_Pieces" * 3 WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "integer" FROM "performance" LOOP IF rec."integer" IS NULL THEN DELETE FROM "performance" WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; INSERT INTO "performance" ("Attendance", "integer") VALUES (var1, 'fallback'); ELSE INSERT INTO "performance" ("Attendance", "integer") VALUES (para_Attendance, para_integer); FOR rec IN SELECT ctid AS row_id, "Num_of_Pieces" FROM "member_attendance" LOOP IF rec."Num_of_Pieces" > 100 THEN UPDATE "member_attendance" SET "Performance_ID" = 'final_state' WHERE ctid = rec.row_id; END IF; END LOOP; END IF; END; $$;
CALL sp_orig(25, 3, 1800, 'x');
